ELMT Stinger Preview

Revised stinger transition for the broadcast package — slowed to 1.8 seconds, petals dimmed onto a dark backing so it no longer strobes, and the scene behind the cut is fully hidden at the peak. Watch it over the sample map scene to judge it the way viewers will see it, then drop feedback in the thread.

Behind it

Reduced motion is on in your system settings, so the video is hidden. It's a 1.8s animated transition.

The video has real transparency (VP9 alpha) — whatever you pick above shows through exactly like the live scene will in OBS. Safari can't decode VP9 alpha; use Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.

What changed from the first version

  • Slower and calmer — 1.8s instead of 1.1s, and the pinwheel makes a slow partial turn instead of whipping through almost a full rotation.
  • No more strobe — the second counter-spinning wheel is now a subtle background layer instead of a second full-brightness wheel; the flickering overlap is gone.
  • Dark backing — a near-black wash fades in behind the petals, so they read as glass on dark instead of raw neon over the gameplay, and the scene swap hides behind it.
  • Softer accents — the rainbow band is dimmed to about half strength and the ELMT wordmark fades in instead of flashing white.

Using it in OBS

Scene Transitions dock → + → Stinger → pick the downloaded file → Transition Point: 950 ms. Download the file from the production app under Settings → 🎬 Stinger (WebM) once the v2.1.0 update lands (the file on this page is the same render).
